info.title: Stellar Blaze API (v1 contract, hand-written from the B3 plan)
info.description: Hand-written from B3 plan Task 0 and Task 17, ADRs 0050, 0051, 0054, 0057 and 0058, until backend/openapi/v1.json carries the real contract (B3 Task 0, noon 15 Nov); then Task 24 swaps this file. Properties and operations marked x-sb-requested are gaps the frontend asked B3 for (R1 ban_window, R2 crew task, workload, shift and sign-off state, R3 sign-off items, G1 demo reset, G2 site phones); they are not in the B3 plan text. Every non-2xx response is application/problem+json (RFC 9457 shape plus request_id). Version strings are opaque to the UI: policy_version and RiskPolicy.version carry the backend ruleset id (ADR 0009); config_version is the integer id of the active runtime configuration (ADR 0010). Every instant is ISO 8601 UTC.

get.summary: The hourly WBGT forecast and site level for a site's local day.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The site's local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Missing: the site's local today in live mode, the replay default date in replay mode (ADR 0051 decision 4).

200.description: Hourly forecast for the site's local day, 06:00 to 19:00 local.

get.summary: The active risk policy the device uses to compute personal risk.
List the crews of a site.
Crew-level aggregate timeline for one day (k-suppressed below k).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The crew's site's local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Missing: as for the site forecast.

200.description: Aggregates only; never one person's state.

get.summary: The crew's rule plan for one day, checked by the independent validator.
get.description: Employer token, own employer only. Advisory only: the employer remains the duty-holder. Never cache (NetworkOnly).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The crew's site's local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Missing: as for the site forecast.

post.summary: Sign the crew's day plan off (B3 Task 17; ADR 0011 section 7.1).
post.description: Employer token, own employer only. One-tap sign-off is allowed only when the plan equals the last accepted plan and has no Medium, High or Red work item; otherwise every item of DayPlan.ack_items must be listed in acknowledged_items, else 409 review-required with the missing ids. Sign-off never delays an alert or a stop. The 200 body is the plan as signed.

post.summary: Check a typed roster against the rules for one site day (try-a-plan).
post.description: Public. Exactly one of roster_text and segments. A roster that cannot be parsed is 422 roster-invalid.

post.summary: Register a Web Push subscription for site and optional crew alerts.
An employer's request for one worker's individual data. Always refused and logged.
post.description: Employer token. The answer is always 403 urn:stellar-blaze:problem:individual-data-refused (ADR 0054); worker_ref is validated and discarded, never stored, logged or echoed. Without a token: 401.

get.summary: The worker-visible log of refused employer requests at a site, newest first, at most 50.

post.summary: Record a crew-lead stop. It never waits for sign-off, validation or a forecast.
post.description: Employer token, own employer only. The row means the stop is recorded; the API does not confirm that anyone was alerted (ADR 0058: no HTTP push trigger).

delete.summary: Clear a crew-lead stop (the 10 second undo, or the end of the stop). Idempotent.

post.summary: Start a new demo epoch for a synthetic site.
post.description: Candidate operation, not yet confirmed with B3. Valid only for a site with synthetic: true (else 403). Employer token. Crew stops and sign-offs revert to the seed; the transparency log is append-only and keeps every row. A real API may answer 404 or 501.

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Site id of a synthetic site.

EmployerBearer.description: The demo employer token. The browser never holds it: the BFF injects it on an allow-list of method and path pairs (src/app/api/v1/[...path]/employer-auth.ts).

XRequestId.description: Correlation id of this request. Repeated as request_id in every problem body.

Unauthorized.description: No bearer token, or an unknown one.

Forbidden.description: The token's employer may not do this, or the request is refused by rule.

ReviewRequired.description: Conflict. For sign-off: review-required, listing the missing item ids in missing_items. Other problems of status 409 use Problem.

RosterInvalid.description: The request failed validation, or the roster could not be parsed: roster-invalid lists errors by line.

Unprocessable.description: The request failed validation. A roster that cannot be parsed lists its errors (RosterInvalidProblem).

BadGateway.description: The API could not reach a dependency.

Level.description: Heat level. Never shown by colour alone.

Zone.description: ADOSH zone of the effective TWL with a fourth stop edge (ADR 0046).

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

request_id.description: Same value as the X-Request-ID response header.

missing_items.description: Ids from DayPlan.ack_items that acknowledged_items did not list.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; the UI renders every time in it.

supervisor_phone.description: E.164 style number of the site supervisor, null when the site has none on file. SYNTHETIC on the demo site.

first_aider_phone.description: E.164 style number of the site first-aider, null when the site has none on file. SYNTHETIC on the demo site.

ban_active.description: Midday work ban in force during this hour.

policy_version.description: Backend ruleset id (ae-heat-<yyyy>.<n>). Shown verbatim, never parsed.

mode.description: replay: a recorded day; stamped on every screen that shows forecast data.

forecast_status.description: stale and fallback are never drawn as live. fallback: no usable forecast, every hour has site_level null (ADR 0058).

lead_days.description: Forecast lead in days: 1 is about 24 hours ahead.

ban_window.description: The midday work ban of this date as UTC instants: 12:30 to 15:00 local, 15 Jun to 15 Sep inclusive local dates, otherwise null. The UI never writes these edges as literals.

version.description: Backend ruleset id (ae-heat-<yyyy>.<n>). Shown verbatim, never parsed.

config_version.description: Must equal the forecast's config_version before the device computes personal risk.

k_suppression.description: Smallest crew size whose aggregates are shown (k_exposure, ADR 0050).

k_health.description: Smallest group behind any health-related count (ADR 0050).

task_label.description: What the crew is doing today, for example Concrete pour. Task allocation, shown to the crew's own supervisor.

workload.description: The crew's workload class (a crew input, not a member reading).

crew_level.description: The crew's level for this hour: the site level of that hour, raised to red by a crew-lead stop (ADR 0050). Derived only from server-held inputs for the site and the crew, never from personal risk reported by a device (ADR 0004: personal risk is never sent to the server). It carries no member-derived information, which is why it is also returned for a suppressed crew. Null when there is no data.

suppressed.description: True when the crew has fewer than k members (k_exposure). It withholds member-derived fields only, such as the restricted headcount of the day plan; crew_level carries no member-derived information (it comes from site and crew inputs, or is null): nothing in the response may single out a member.

ban_window.description: As SiteForecastToday.ban_window, for the crew's site and this date.

shift.description: The crew's published shift blocks for this date, as UTC instants.

signoff_state.description: Whether the crew's day plan is signed off. Never gates an alert or a stop.

id.description: One acknowledgement is one run of consecutive plan blocks in the same zone above low. Format ack-<zone>-<HHMM>, the local start time, for example ack-high-1000. Unique within a day plan.

text_code.description: Action code the client maps to text, for example cycle.medium.heavy.45-15 or stop-work.

signoff_state.description: Widened from the unsigned-only value of B3 Task 0 by the sign-off decision (ADR 0051 amendment). With no sign-off the plan stays unsigned (plan.unsigned_fallback).

restricted_headcount.description: Members limited by acclimatisation, the 7-day heavy rule or the juvenile rule. Null when suppressed.

ack_items.description: The items that need a per-item acknowledgement before sign-off, in time order.

acclimatised.description: Optional; true when omitted (the default is applied by the API, not declared here, so the generated type stays optional).

days_per_week.description: Optional; 6 when omitted (applied by the API).

oneOf.description: One line per segment: HH:MM-HH:MM work|rest|break, # comments allowed.

worker_ref.description: Free text; validated and discarded. Never stored, logged or echoed.

acknowledged_items.description: Ids of the DayPlan.ack_items the supervisor ticked.

epoch.description: The new demo epoch, counting from 1.
